name: git undo cheats
body:
git restore <file>              # drop unstaged changes
git restore --staged <file>     # unstage
git reset --soft HEAD~1         # undo last commit, keep changes staged
git commit --amend --no-edit    # add staged changes to last commit
git reflog                      # find a lost commit
git reset --hard ORIG_HEAD      # undo a bad merge/rebase
git revert <sha>                # undo a pushed commit safely
